description: Change a Microsoft Advertising ad account’s account-level settings (Microsoft’s SetAccountProperties). They apply to EVERY campaign in the account. Settable: TrackingUrlTemplate and FinalUrlSuffix ("" clears them), MSCLKIDAutoTaggingEnabled, AdClickParallelTracking (true only, Microsoft made it mandatory), IncludeViewThroughConversions, ProfileExpansionEnabled, AllowImageAutoRetrieve, BusinessAttributes (an array or a semicolon list of Microsoft’s attribute names, "" clears), AssetAIEnhancementOptout and AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy. Readable but refused here, by name: AutoApplyRecommendations (use set_microsoft_ads_auto_apply), the Nielsen and Netflix terms acceptances (a person accepts terms, not an agent), and properties whose values Microsoft does not document. confirm:true is required to turn ProfileExpansionEnabled ON (it widens reach and can raise spend), to turn AllowImageAutoRetrieve ON (it grants Microsoft a licence to your site images), and for ANY AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy value: Microsoft has not documented those values, so read the property first, tell the user that, and pass the value verbatim. Microsoft sets all or none. A value already in place is not sent. THE ANSWER IS THE READ-BACK: per property done / not done / could not tell, with the previous value and the call that restores it. Report that, never the fact that the call returned. 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

confirm.description: the user said yes. Required for ProfileExpansionEnabled=true, AllowImageAutoRetrieve=true and any AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy value

properties.description: map of account property name to value, e.g. {"MSCLKIDAutoTaggingEnabled": true}, {"FinalUrlSuffix": "utm_source=bing"} or {"AIDetectedContentWatermarkPolicy": "<value read from get_microsoft_ads_account_properties>"}

name: set_microsoft_ads_account_properties
title: Change Microsoft Advertising account settings
